hypothesis.definition_origin: Venture Coinist X post and user-supplied TradingView chart
hypothesis.source_claim: Bitcoin buying opportunities occur when Bitcoin 30-day realized volatility falls below QQQ 30-day realized volatility.
hypothesis.decision_information: At the regular QQQ close, use QQQ adjusted closes through that session and only BTC UTC daily closes whose availability timestamp is no later than the QQQ decision timestamp.
hypothesis.target_instrument: BTC spot using BTC-USD daily closes as the research return proxy
hypothesis.benchmark: Calendar-year and source-exposure-matched unconditional BTC entries; primary inference uses nonoverlapping 90-calendar-day events.
invalid_regimes: overlapping trigger cluster counted as independent evidence
hypothesis.deactivation_rule: Retire or redesign if ten untouched prospective nonoverlapping triggers show non-positive 90-day after-cost edge versus the matched benchmark, if the result remains confined to one market cycle, or if archived trigger reconstruction fails.
hypothesis.timezone: QQQ decisions use America/New_York regular-session close; BTC closes use UTC midnight availability
hypothesis.source_fidelity_notes: The image supports the broad relative-volatility claim but exposes neither machine-readable marker dates nor indicator source code. Exact source-marker reproduction is not claimed.
hypothesis.entry_rule: Enter the research return calculation at the first completed BTC UTC daily close strictly after the QQQ-close decision timestamp.
hypothesis.exit_rule: Score 30, 90, 180 and 365 calendar-day exits independently at the first BTC UTC daily close on or after the target date. Score recross exit separately as a diagnostic.
hypothesis.direction_rule: Long BTC only; no leverage and no short variant in the canonical test.
hypothesis.trigger_rule: On comparable QQQ trading dates, calculate sample standard deviation of close-to-close log returns within the preceding 30 calendar days. Annualize BTC with sqrt(365) and QQQ with sqrt(252). Trigger only on a fresh crossover from BTC realized volatility greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility to strictly below it, and re-arm only after a recross.
hypothesis.cost_model: Subtract 20 basis points round trip from every event return; funding is inapplicable to the spot proxy.
hypothesis.out_of_sample_boundary: 2026-08-04. Earlier history is source-exposed because the chart displayed historical markers; 2014-09-17 through 2021-12-31 is development and 2022-01-01 through 2026-08-03 is historical validation but not untouched.
